raw:
@s1 stated
  relation "move to"
  role subject "the user"
  role destination "Brașov"
  role source "Leeds"
  role time "last spring"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s2 stated
  relation "rent a flat in Schei from"
  role subject "the user"
  role object "Mrs Stoica"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s3 stated
  relation "mention"
  role subject "Mrs Stoica"
  role object "the centrala needs a revizie before the heating season"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@a1 assumed
  relation "be required by law"
  role subject "a revizie of the centrala"
  role time "every two years"
  polarity affirmed
  basis implicature

@q query
  where match
    relation "be a legal requirement"
    role subject "a revizie of the centrala"
    role time "every two years"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q2 query
  select ?p
  where match
    relation "be responsible for paying for"
    role subject ?p
    role object "a revizie of the centrala"
    polarity affirmed
  end
